sections.text:
[Effects]
Reduces physical damage taken by M+.
Reduces magic damage taken by M+.
Increases status ailment resistance by 4XL+.
Target: yourself. Applies an invulnerability effect that nullifies physical or magic damage 1 time.

[Activation]
When physical or magic damage is taken.

[Activation Rate]
M
Activation rate scales with the number of Dark elemental Helm/Hat/Armor/Clothing type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of L+ (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 3).
